en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a humorous montage: in the upper part, a man in an overcoat, bowler hat, and suit is seen floating in the sky while holding an open umbrella and a suitcase. Below him is a panoramic view over a small European town with dense rooftops, trees in the foreground, and a river to the right. German text is printed beneath the image, with publisher information at the bottom.
